title: Kernel computation for punctured restriction
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let W be its spectrum minus the closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let M be any R-module. The kernel of tilde.toOpen M W equals Ideal.primaryComponent M m [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor], where m is the maximal ideal. No injectivity of M is required.

source.place: Tag 0A6T, proof of Lemma 51.2.1 (localizations on the complement); kernel argument written by J4 using the annihilator radical

proof.text: Identify tilde.toOpen with the concrete section of StructureSheaf.toOpenₗ through modulesSpecToSheafIso. For x with zero restriction, set J = Ann(Rx). If a prime P contains J and differs from m, evaluate the zero section at P in W. LocalizedModule.mk_eq supplies a denominator outside P annihilating x, contradicting J ≤ P. Thus every prime containing J contains m; Ideal.radical_eq_sInf gives m ≤ radical J.

Apply Ideal.exists_pow_le_of_le_radical_of_fg to m ≤ radical J and Noetherian finite generation of m, obtaining m^n ≤ J. Submodule.mem_annihilator_span_singleton and Ideal.primaryComponent_mem give the forward inclusion.

Conversely, for x killed by m^n and a prime P in W, maximality and P ≠ m give a in m outside P. The scalar a^n kills x, so LocalizedModule.mk_eq makes its value at P zero. Subtype.ext and funext show the concrete section is zero. This includes empty W and exponent zero.

lean.statement:
theorem injective_punctured_restriction_kernel
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) :
    (tilde.toOpen M W).hom.ker = Ideal.primaryComponent M (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
